description: This file defines the LineFormat class, which encapsulates the formatting settings for a line within shape objects in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel. It includes properties like visibility, width, color, dash style, and line style, along with serialization support.

classes.name: LineFormat
classes.description: Represents the formatting options for a line in a shape, including visibility, width, color, dash style, and style. It supports serialization and deep copying.

classes.name: LineFormat.LineFormatValues
classes.description: Holds the internal nullable values for the properties of LineFormat, enabling optional property settings and serialization.

methods.name: LineFormat
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of LineFormat.

methods.name: LineFormat( DocumentObject parent )
methods.description: Internal constructor used to initialize a new instance with a specified parent.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the LineFormat instance.
